title: Backyard Island - Nostalgia With a Learning Loop
author: Sad_Wafer9427
selftext:
I recently developed this game with the help of AI.

Some things I’ve learned:

1. The AI settings are very important- Claude Opus Medium Thinking will be completely different than Claude High or x/High + Ultracode turned on.

2. Expectations - realistic 3D scenes Claude will not be able to create with Blender alone. In this game I opted for more of a cartoon feel so it wasn’t necessary.

3. This took about 4 weeks on a $200 plan and at points it ran overnight. Thinking you can vibe code a game in 3 days is just not possible.

4. Creativity - Take things you love from different game rather than clone the game. This game took inspirations from Backyard Soccer, Mario 64 (Running Animation), and Mario Kart.

My plans are to keep this free as long as possible. It’s meant for everyone. 

Future development to include treasure hunting, with inspiration from sea of thieves Hope y’all like it!! Open to suggestions as well.

Updates to come soon.
